title: Puravankara to invest ₹800 crore to construct new housing project in Kochi
description:
Realty firm Puravankara Ltd will invest around Rs 800 crore over the next four years in the construction of a premium housing project here, as part of its expansion plan, a senior company official said on Wednesday.
The company has launched a new housing project, 'Purva Cityspire', which is part of its 18-acre township, Purva City, at Edappally in Kochi.
"We are launching a new project in our 18-acre township. The total apartments will be 1,056," said Mallanna Sasalu, CEO-South, Puravankara.
When asked about the project cost, he said the company already owns the land.
"The investment on pure construction will be around Rs 800 crore," he told PTI.
The estimated revenue potential from this upcoming project is about Rs 2,000 crore, Sasalu said.
Homes range from 1,271 sq ft to 1,895 sq ft, with prices starting at Rs 1.44 crore.
The construction work will start soon, and the project is expected to be completed in four years.
